questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to RAPID.
questions.e: Rapid means very quick, and swift means the same.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to ABUNDANT.
questions.e: Abundant means existing in large quantities, which is plentiful. Scarce and rare are its opposites.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to COMMENCE.
questions.e: To commence is to begin or start.

questions.q:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the word in capitals.
The manager was FURIOUS at the delay.
Choose the word closest in meaning to CANDID.
questions.e: Candid means open and honest in speech, which is frank. Secretive is the opposite.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to MEAGRE.
questions.e: Meagre means small in quantity or inadequate, i.e. scanty.

questions.q:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the word in capitals.
The scientist's findings were CORROBORATED by a second team.
questions.e: To corroborate is to support a claim with further evidence, i.e. to confirm it.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to OBSTINATE.
questions.e: Obstinate means refusing to change one's mind, which is stubborn.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to PERFUNCTORY.
questions.e: Perfunctory means done with minimum effort and little care, as in a cursory glance. Thorough is its opposite.

questions.q:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the word in capitals.
The OBSEQUIOUS clerk bowed repeatedly before the officer.
questions.e: Obsequious means excessively eager to please or obey, which is servile.
